chiXiaoFullCardPrompt:
Use case: compositing / collectible card design. Reference image 1 is the APPROVED STYLE REFERENCE, a finished Chun Jun sword card. Create a NEW companion card for the Chinese legendary sword CHI XIAO, exact title "赤霄", small English "CHI XIAO", small series text "名剑录" at top.
This is a complete premium collectible card FRONT, flat straight-on portrait 5:7, 1060x1484. Match the reference's art quality, rich gilded sculptural frame, chamfered corners, stepped lacquer/bronze bevels, cloud-and-dragon corner relief, top series cartouche and large embossed bottom Chinese title. These design elements should clearly belong to the SAME SET.
INDIVIDUALITY: The sword and scene must be distinct from Chun Jun, not a palette-swapped copy. Chi Xiao sword is a slender silver-grey double-edged Chinese jian, fine gold cloud engraving and a narrow warm-red ridge glint, a small elegant gold guard shaped like spread cloud wings, burgundy woven grip and flattened oval gold pommel with red stone. No emerald hilt, no diamond-pattern green blade. Entire sword visible, raised diagonally from hilt in LOWER LEFT of artwork to blade tip in UPPER RIGHT, with a short red silk tassel below hilt. Sword within x=15..84%, y=10..77%, clear elegant silhouette, no giant European crossguard and no katana curve.
BACKGROUND: vast layered Chinese cloud sea at sunrise, a vermilion sun near upper left, distant red-black palace roof silhouettes and mountains below, a subtle auspicious Chinese dragon shape formed from pale gold clouds sweeps behind the sword. Restrained flowing red silk and golden sparks, cinematic lacquer-red/gold rim lighting. NO jade ring, NO broken celestial disk, NO mountain gateway from the reference. Overall deep vermilion, wine-red lacquer, warm gold, ink-blue shadows, cloud ivory. Keep contrast so the cool silver blade stands clearly against red/gold sky.
Frame materials use same stepped gold-and-lacquer design language but dark oxblood lacquer inlays replace jade green. Bottom title "赤霄" in large legible embossed gold, tiny CHI XIAO below, top 名剑录. No other text, no stats, no game UI, no humans, no watermark. Card fills canvas, no external mockup margins. Painterly depth, luxury physical foil, sophisticated Chinese fantasy achievement card. Creative interpretation, not historical reconstruction.
